name: haina-upward-management
description: Clarify manager instructions, assess feedback evidence, and prepare upward communication.

displayDescription.zh: 帮助员工澄清上级要求、核对工作评价证据，准备向上沟通与复盘，以事实减少误解并守住个人边界。
displayDescription.en: Clarifies manager requirements, assesses work-feedback evidence, and prepares communication and reviews without mind-reading or personality scores.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我澄清上级这段指令，并准备一条确认消息。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Clarify this instruction and draft a confirmation message.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我澄清上级这段指令，并准备一条确认消息。
quickPrompts.en: Clarify this instruction and draft a confirmation message.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据这些材料，帮我核对上级对我工作的评价证据。
quickPrompts.en: Assess evidence about my manager's feedback on my work.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我准备一次向上沟通，或复盘上次沟通的结果。
quickPrompts.en: Prepare a manager conversation or review its outcome.
